title: Restriction of an etale relation preserves its quotient
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U$ be a scheme over $S$, and let $(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product] be an etale equivalence relation: $R(T)$ is an equivalence relation on $U(T)$ for every $S$-scheme $T$, and $s,t$ are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $g:U'\to U$ be any etale morphism, and set $R'=U'\times_{g,U,s}R\times_{t,U,g}U'$ with its induced two maps to $U'$. Then $R'\to U'\times_SU'$ is an etale equivalence relation, and the canonical map from the sheaf quotient of $U'$ by $R'$ to the sheaf quotient $F$ of $U$ by $R$ on $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site, def-weil-pbc-sheafification] is injective; if $g$ is surjective, this canonical map is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 02WT and 045Z (pullback/restriction of a pre-equivalence relation), together with the surjective-cover clause of Tag 045Z.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-etale-pullback-relation-presheaf]. Substitute its first two canonical projection equalities. Its conclusions give monicity, the equivalence-relation axioms and etaleness of both restricted projections. Retain its sectionwise injective quotient-presheaf map v and its compatibility with the coequalizer projections.

The universal property [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the given restricted quotient sheaf extends v followed by η to α with η′ followed by α equal to v followed by η. Composing with the restricted coequalizer projection and using Step 1 gives exactly the asserted canonical compatibility. For either universal map, sheafify its image subfunctor inside the target sheaf. The universal property gives a retraction of the inclusion, and uniqueness gives that the retraction is a right inverse. Hence the locally generated image is the whole target, proving local surjectivity without a global small-valued sheafification instance.

By [lem-trf-fppf-universal-unit-locally-injective], η is locally injective in the stated small value universe. Sectionwise injectivity of v implies local injectivity, so v followed by η is locally injective. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac cancels the locally surjective η′ in the equality of Step 2. Thus α is locally injective. Separatedness of F′ makes every component injective, giving Mono α.

If g is surjective, its flatness and local finite presentation make its singleton family an fppf cover [def-pc-fppf-site]. Pull back the generated covering sieve along a section into U; every arrow in the resulting sieve factors through g, so yoneda.map g is locally surjective. The original coequalizer projection is sectionwise surjective by Step 1. Composing it with η and yoneda.map g gives a locally surjective map. Step 2 identifies this map with the restricted quotient projection followed by η′ and α; Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac gives local surjectivity of α. Apply Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso and map the resulting sheaf isomorphism to presheaves.

lean.statement: theorem etale_relation_restriction_quotient {S : Scheme.{u}} {R U U' : Over S} (s t : R ⟶ U) [Mono (prod.lift s t)] (hrel : ∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ U ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ R, r ≫ s = a ∧ r ≫ t = b)) (g : U' ⟶ U) [Etale s.left] [Etale t.left] [Etale g.left] (F : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η : coequalizer (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ⟶ F.obj) (hη : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun k : F.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ k)) (F' : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η' : coequalizer (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g)) (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g)) ⟶ F'.obj) (hη' : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun k : F'.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η' ≫ k)) : Mono (prod.lift (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g) (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g)) ∧ (∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ U' ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ restrictedEtaleRelation s t g, r ≫ restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g = a ∧ r ≫ restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g = b)) ∧ Etale (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g).left ∧ Etale (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g).left ∧ ∃ α : F'.obj ⟶ F.obj, (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g)) (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g)) ≫ η') ≫ α = yoneda.map g ≫ (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η) ∧ Mono α ∧ (Surjective g.left → IsIso α)
lean.note: The restricted relation and its projections are the actual iterated pullbacks in Over S. The two sheaf quotients are specified by their sheafification universal properties at the presheaf coequalizers, following the existing EtaleRelationQuotient interface. The quotient-projection compatibility uniquely determines the canonical map alpha; Mono alpha is equivalent to injectivity on every test scheme. No global sheafification-existence assumption is imposed on the big site.
